annotations.title: Apply Promo, Open-Hardware Grant, or VIP Beta Pass to Job

description: Apply a promotional discount, Open-Hardware Grant ('OPENHW' -> $0.00), Founding Prototype Pass ('PROTOTYPE1' -> $1.00 USDC), Founder Credit ('FOUNDER100' -> -$100.00), or Invited Builder VIP Pass ('XBUILDER' -> $0.00) to an existing compiled job_id. Call this tool after calligraphy_compile_board when a user provides a promo or grant code for an unpaid job. Requires job_id and promo_code; OPENHW also requires showcase_opt_in=True and a public social_or_repo_url. Returns JSON with job_id, promo_code, unlocked, final_price_usd, and updated stablecoin_checkout instructions.

customer_email.description: Valid corporate or engineering email address associated with the job or VIP invite. Example: 'builder@hardware.io'.

job_id.description: Target compilation job identifier returned by calligraphy_compile_board. Example: 'job_a1b2c3d4'.

promo_code.description: Case-insensitive promo or grant code ('OPENHW', 'PROTOTYPE1', 'FOUNDER100', 'UPGRADE150', or 'XBUILDER').

showcase_opt_in.description: Grant permission to feature OPSEC-scrubbed raster renders in the Calligraphy community showcase (required for 'OPENHW').

social_or_repo_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub repository or social post URL verifying open-source project status for 'OPENHW' grants. Example: 'https://github.com/org/open-pcb'.

name: calligraphy_apply_promo
title: Apply Promo, Open-Hardware Grant, or VIP Beta Pass to Job
